cases.name: Margaret E. Jensen
cases.about: Her obituary said, "In her early years, she found a love for racing at Hawkeye Downs. More recently, Margaret was a proud business owner of Margaret’s Turf Care, and also enjoyed her time bartending at Haddy’s in Center Point. She was known for her big heart. Margaret was always full of life and cared for all creatures big and small, especially horses."
